mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is confirmed by consecutive monthly decreases.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days when both series fall simultaneously.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for 3 consecutive months signals manufacturing supply shock, reducing output capacity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real consumer spending (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS grows for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 203.0 (as of t-1mo) signals accelerating inflation, prompting persistent high interest rates that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 203.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months indicates labor market contraction, reducing consumer income and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.5%) signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5%.
